why_exists: Acts as the root prompt contract loaded first in every LLM chat/intake turn. Defines the mandatory pre-flight instructions (PRE_FLIGHT_EXTRACTION) and output format (M0_OUTPUT_SCHEMA).
business_rules: Controls the intent-change lock, sector mapping classification, and the redundancy-skipping map (preventing users from being asked duplicate questions about details they already provided).
fragile_conditions: Modifying output JSON keys will break the backend parsing parser. The completion gate (is_complete=false on the same turn M4 questions are introduced) must remain intact to prevent early intake closure.
blast_radius: Universal chat and document ingestion flow. Any syntax issue or key change here breaks every prompt turn, intent detection, and matchmaking pipeline.
